+Deterministic generation is based on the selected certificate generation year. This means that if
+mkcert is run on the same definitions file twice with the same year, it will produce the same
+certificates. One exception to this is the pkcs12 format; the cryptography library does not provide
functionality for generating pkcs12 bundles deterministically.
+Bazel first extracts the UTC year from stable workspace status into a dedicated year file, then
+passes that file to mkcert. Only the extraction action depends on the complete stable-status file,
+so unrelated status changes can reuse cached certificate generation while a UTC year change
